workflows.description: Critique a completed turn or durable workflow episode from authoritative evidence, persist the assessment as episodic memory, and optionally launch bounded maintenance follow-up.
workflows.content: Workflow-first actor/critic evaluation for completed chat turns and durable workflow episodes. Builds an authoritative evidence bundle, asks a high-quality critic prompt for a bounded judgement, persists the result as episode memory, and launches maintenance only when the assessment recommends reusable follow-up.

llm_policy.response_contract_text: Return JSON with keys verdict, confidence, unresolved_check_count, summary, maintenance_follow_up_recommended, maintenance_follow_up_reason, recommendations, root_causes, and improvement_suggestions.

workflows.content: Axis-specific evaluator workflow for grounded helpfulness. Consumes the shared episode evidence bundle, answer artefacts, answer-support evidence, and retained context-lineage signals, then returns a bounded grounded_helpfulness assessment for later persistence and benchmarking.
